- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Rajya Sabha allows for healthy debates and discussions on issues concerning minority communities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Rajya Sabha has a say in the appointment of public officials, including judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Rajya Sabha plays a significant role in protecting the rights of minority communities in India by ensuring their representation, scrutinizing legislation, promoting discussions, and appointing public officials.
